Lighting Installation & Repairs Perth FAQs

Prepare the request and approval

Give the property location, observable symptoms or intended installation, access contact and the person who can approve the work. The agreed quote sets out the assessment and work; submitting a form does not reserve an appointment.

  • Perth electrical services
  • Lighting and outlet service overview

  • Ceiling fans with lights

  • Bathroom Exhaust Fan Replacement Perth
Why do LED lights flicker when connected to a dimmer?

The lamp, driver and dimmer may not be compatible, but a connection or supply problem can also cause flickering. An electrician assesses the installation before deciding which part needs attention. Do not remove a fitting to investigate.

Can you repair flickering LED downlights in Perth?

Yes. We assess the affected lighting and quote for the agreed repair or replacement. Tell us whether one light, a room or several circuits are affected, and whether the dimmer or a large appliance changes the symptom.

Should I buy replacement fittings first?

Discuss the product first. Dimensions, controls, driver requirements and ceiling access can affect suitability. The quote confirms who supplies the fitting and which installation work is included.

Does replacing a light include new wiring?

Only wiring included in the agreed scope. A like-for-like fitting replacement and a new lighting location may require different work; the existing installation must be checked before the scope is settled.
